flags.why: Bồ hòn does not mean to have no worries, so this sense teaches an invented meaning.
This expression is local to Hải Phòng and needs a Northern warning, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bồng_cốt).
The common meaning referring to a high-pitched voice or sound is missing, as documented in [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/bổng).
flags.fix: Add an adjective sense: high-pitched (of a voice or sound).
